dmirs2019.title: Department of Mines, Industry Regulation and Safety (2019, act. 2025). Ground control management in Western Australian mining operations: Guideline

items.instrument: DMIRS (2019) Ground control management in Western Australian mining operations: Guideline

summary.es: FS mínimo con consecuencia moderadamente seria (la consecuencia no seria no tiene criterio).
summary.en: Minimum FoS for a moderately serious consequence (a not serious consequence has no criterion).

items.instrument: DMIRS (2019) Ground control management in Western Australian mining operations: Guideline

summary.es: FS mínimo con consecuencia seria o de largo plazo (depósito de relaves, rampa principal, falla grande hacia zonas de trabajo).
summary.en: Minimum FoS for a serious or long-term consequence (tailings storage, main ramp, large failure towards work areas).

items.instrument: DMIRS (2019) Ground control management in Western Australian mining operations: Guideline

summary.es: FS mínimo con consecuencia extrema o de largo plazo (taludes permanentes que afectan infraestructura pública después del cierre).
summary.en: Minimum FoS for an extreme or long-term consequence (permanent slopes affecting public infrastructure after closure).
